# Cloudflare Agent Setup

For Cloudflare work in this repository:

- Install Cloudflare Skills with:
  npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/skills
- Configure the Cloudflare API MCP at:
  https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp
- Use the Cloudflare docs MCP at:
  https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp
- Use Wrangler for local development and deployment.
- Complete Cloudflare OAuth in the coding agent when prompted.
- Verify Cloudflare account, zone, DNS, and deployment targets before changing anything.
- Never commit API tokens or secrets.

Reference:
https://developers.cloudflare.com/agent-setup/
